Help shape a more efficient and resilient global vaccine distribution network

Can you turn complex logistics data into practical improvements?

Do you know how to challenge transport flows, strengthen supplier performance and uncover what drives distribution costs?

And would you like to build capabilities that continue to make a difference beyond your assignment?

At Bavarian Nordic, we are looking for a Global Distribution Network Optimization Lead to improve our global distribution network and strengthen the tools, insights and ways of working behind it.

This position is initially established for approximately 12–18 months to deliver priority network improvements and build a lasting capability within Global Distribution & Logistics.

**Your role

**You will assess how our distribution network performs today and identify how it can better balance cost, service, lead time, capacity and resilience. Turning network data and operational insights into a prioritized roadmap, you will work with colleagues and logistics partners to put agreed improvements into practice.

You will report to the Head of Global Distribution & Logistics. The role has no direct reports, so your impact will come through your analytical expertise, project leadership and ability to create alignment across functions.

You will collaborate closely with Distribution Leads, Global Planning, Regional Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain Compliance, Quality and the I2O Process Manager, as well as logistics service providers and carriers.

**What You Will Do

**Your responsibilities will cover three connected areas:

Optimize the distribution network

• Assess the current network and develop a prioritized optimization roadmap covering cost, service, lead time, capacity and risk.

• Analyse distribution lanes, shipment profiles, routes, transport modes and network flows to identify improvement opportunities.

• Build transparency on distribution costs and cost-to-serve to support informed decisions.

• Identify opportunities for shipment consolidation, routing improvements, changes in transport mode and network redesign.

• Lead or support the implementation of agreed changes, working with Distribution Leads to turn recurring operational issues into lasting improvements.

**Strengthen supplier strategy and performance

**

• Develop logistics supplier and carrier strategies in close collaboration with Procurement.

• Establish a supplier performance framework with clear KPIs, governance, performance reviews and improvement plans.

• Support logistics tenders, supplier selection and contract optimization.

• Work with suppliers, carriers and internal stakeholders to deliver measurable improvements in cost and service.

**Build Capabilities That Last

**

• Establish analytical tools, standards and governance that make network optimization an ongoing part of how we work.

• Support future digital ways of working, including the use of transportation management systems (TMS) to improve visibility and decision support.

• Build and transfer knowledge so that colleagues can sustain and develop the capability beyond the assignment.

**What Success Looks Like

**During the assignment, you will establish a clear network optimization roadmap and a prioritized set of improvement opportunities. You will provide better visibility of distribution costs, develop practical lane and routing recommendations, and put a supplier performance framework and strategy in place.

Success will also mean implementing changes that deliver tangible improvements in cost, service and network resilience—and leaving colleagues with the tools and knowledge to continue that work.

**What You Bring

**You have strong experience in logistics, transportation, distribution or supply chain network optimization. You understand both the commercial drivers of a distribution network and the operational realities of making changes work.

**We are looking for someone with:

**

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex data into practical business decisions.

• Experience in logistics sourcing, tenders, carrier management and supplier performance management.

• A strong commercial and cost mindset, with the ability to assess trade-offs across service, lead time, capacity and risk.

• Strong project and change management skills, including the ability to move improvements from analysis into implementation.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence across functions.

**How You Work

**You combine a strategic perspective with a practical approach. You are comfortable challenging existing arrangements but take the time to understand operational needs before recommending changes.

You create clarity around opportunities, priorities and expected benefits, and bring colleagues with you through implementation. You also share your knowledge openly, helping others take ownership of new tools and ways of working.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**This is an opportunity to deliver meaningful improvements within a defined assignment while shaping how global distribution develops over the longer term. You will influence network decisions, supplier strategies and the analytical capabilities that support reliable vaccine distribution.

At Bavarian Nordic, we work to improve and save lives through vaccines. Our culture values persistence, openness to change and collaboration. In this role, you can put those values into practice by solving complex distribution challenges and building improvements together with colleagues across the business.

**Caught your interest?

**If you are ready to take on a pivotal role in a growing organization and drive meaningful change in healthcare, apply now and join Bavarian Nordic in our mission to improve health outcomes and foster sustainable growth.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

As a Senior Planning Specialist, Global Planning, you will play a key role in strengthening and continuously improving Ambu’s global planning capabilities. You will combine data, process expertise and stakeholder collaboration to turn planning information into actionable insights that support better decisions on cost, efficiency, service, and inventory performance.

You will help shape and improve our global planning processes by identifying opportunities, challenging existing ways of working, and translating best practices into scalable solutions. Working closely with stakeholders across Global Supply Chain, you will connect global standards and strategy with effective local execution.

This is more than an analytical role. You will act as a key driver of planning excellence, helping build best-in-class planning processes and enabling smarter, more efficient and resilient ways of working across our global operations.

**Key Responsibilities

****Your mission is to improve our global planning landscape through process excellence, data-driven insights and effective change implementation.

****More Specifically, Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• 
Process Excellence: Assess and continuously improve global planning processes, identifying opportunities to increase efficiency, standardization and scalability across regions.

• 
Change & Implementation: Lead and support implementation of new processes, tools and best practices, ensuring effective adoption and sustainable change across the orgnization.

• 
Stakeholder Partnership: Partner closely with stakeholders across Global Supply Chain to align local execution with global planning standards, processes, and strategic priorities.

• 
Data & Insights: Transform complex planning data into clear, actionable insights that support global decision-making and improve cost, service and operational performance.

• 
Performance Management: Develop, maintain and optimize KPIs, reporting and dashboards to monitor planning performance, identify bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• 
Have 5-7+ years of experience within supply chain planning, planning excellence, process improvement, supply chain analytics, S&OP/IBP, or related areas.

• 
Have solid experience driving process improvements, standardization initiatives, or transformation projects in a complex international supply chain environment.

• 
Are comfortable translating data and business needs into actionable insights, recommendations, and scalable solutions.

• 
Thrive in a stakeholder-facing role and have a proven ability to influence and drive change across functions, regions, and organizational levels.

• 
Combine a strategic mindset with a hands-on approach and enjoy turning ideas and opportunities into tangible improvements.

• 
Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

• 
Experience from MedTech or another complex, regulated industry is an advantage.

Above all, you bring curiosity, ownership, and a passion for continuous improvement. You are naturally proactive, challenge the status quo constructively, and enjoy collaborating with others to turn insights into tangible business improvements. You are equally comfortable working with detailed analyses and broader strategic initiatives, and you thrive in environments where you can make a visible impact on processes and performance.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms.

**Welcome to Generation CE

**You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions.

As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations

• translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes

• ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends

• overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives

• strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams

• promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience

• bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team

• understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry

• have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management

• can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions

• communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Sensing Solutions, we develop advanced sensing technologies supporting applications across the Danfoss portfolio. Our work includes solutions for areas such as data centers, gas sensing, energy-efficient cooling, and environmental monitoring.

As our Development Engineer, you’ll help bring new sensing technologies and product concepts from idea to reality. Working alongside experienced engineers and technology specialists, you’ll contribute to developing products supporting our Data Center, Gas Sensing, and future technology programs.

You’ll have the opportunity to work across different areas of engineering, from mechanical design and prototyping to testing and integration with electronics and software. With a solid foundation in mechanical and electrical engineering and a curiosity to learn, you’ll build hands-on experience while contributing to meaningful product innovation from day one.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**You’ll work across a variety of development activities, gaining exposure to different engineering disciplines while helping bring new ideas and technologies to life.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Supporting the development of new sensing products and technology platforms from concept generation through prototype development and testing

• Creating CAD models, drawings, fixtures, mechanical components, and development tooling to support new product designs

• Building, assembling, and evaluating prototypes, while collecting and analyzing test data to support engineering decisions

• Collaborating with engineers across mechanical, electronics, software, and systems disciplines to mature new concepts and solve technical challenges

• Contributing to design verification, technical investigations, and engineering documentation

As your experience grows, you’ll have the opportunity to develop your skills across product development and explore different technical disciplines based on your strengths and interests.

**What We're Looking For

**You don’t need to have experience in every area of the role. What matters most is a strong mechanical foundation, a practical mindset, and the curiosity and motivation to keep learning.

To be successful in this role, we would expect you to have:

• A BSc or MSc degree in Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline

• A solid understanding of mechanical engineering fundamentals

• Experience using CAD tools for design and engineering documentation

• Practical, hands-on engineering experience gained through work, university projects, internships, or personal projects

• Curiosity, initiative, and an interest in developing your skills across different engineering disciplines

It Would Be An Advantage If You Have Gained Exposure To One Or More Of The Following Through Work, Studies, Projects, Or Personal Interests

• Product development

• Prototyping and testing

• Electronics and sensors

• Software development

**What You'll Get From Us

**You’ll join an environment where collaboration, learning, and continuous development are part of how we work, with the opportunity to broaden your experience as you grow in the role.

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

**Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.

• Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.

• Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.

• Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.

• Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.

• Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

**You’re a great match if

**

• You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team

• You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off

• You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them

• You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team

• You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

**Nice to have

**

• Experience working on live games

**Requirements For Any Job At Triband

**

• You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture

• You value a positive work environment

• You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

**Practicalities

**

• Primarily work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen

• Only open to candidates who are already eligible to work in Denmark as we don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role

• 37-hour work week, with flexible work hours

• No crunch, we put people before deadlines

• Our working language is English

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects

• The chance to contribute to great games that reach millions of players

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights and team events

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of paid vacation

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked

• Pension plan and private health insurance

• Endless amounts of coffee

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

We're looking for an experienced cyber and information security consultant in the GRC domain who has hands-on experience building automation and/or agentic tools into their work.

**What You'll Do

**We're scaling our GRC services team, a team dedicated to making governance, risk, and compliance of cyber and information security more efficient, effective, and valuable to organisations. We do this by automating processes through software and agentic tools, and by defining tasks, inputs, and outputs more clearly than is currently the norm.

As our client list grows, we need someone who can deliver GRC consulting from day one and open up new paths to delivery by developing and implementing our own tools and automations.

This role is open to being shaped by your own passions and talents, whether that's software development, sales and marketing, or deep industry knowledge.

**In This Role, You'll Definitely Be

**

• Helping companies implement and comply with laws, standards, and frameworks like NIS 2, ISO 27001, and the CIS Controls

• Driving projects independently and managing senior stakeholders

• Influencing decisions on cyber and information security at some of Denmark's leading companies and public institutions

**Depending on your experience and interests, you may also be:

**

• Developing your own client networks

• Programming and deploying your own agentic software tools

• Performing technical cybersecurity tasks in client environments

• Building new services from the ground up, targeting industries or problems you understand uniquely well

**What You'll Bring

**You may be a great fit for this role if you have delivered GRC consulting for at least three years, ideally across several clients at once. On top of that, you should have:

• Automated GRC tasks with software and LLMs, refining the output until it beats human work in at least some aspects

• Driven the delivery of software products in collaboration with developers

• Gotten up to speed on new regulatory requirements under tight deadlines

• Fought the least valuable and most dull parts of GRC work while defending the value of good GRC against sceptics and cynics

The ideal candidate must be fluent in English – Danish is a plus, but not required – and we value a relevant master's degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

**To Fit In At The Tech Collective, You Should

**

• Thrive among diverse colleagues, from highly technical security professionals to energetic commercial profiles whose common language is a mix of humour, sarcasm, and passion

• Know how to break down and structure complex assignments, and enjoy sharing your knowledge with your team

• Bring a startup mentality that helps drive the innovation and ingenuity of our GRC services

This role is based in Copenhagen. We combine remote work with meaningful in-person work, and you should expect to be physically present at our office or with clients most of the time.

**What We Offer

**On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer the chance to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. Our expectations are matched by our willingness to invest in your development, whether through training, conferences, or the opportunity to pursue research in areas you're passionate about.

**How To Apply

**We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply ASAP, as the role will close once filled.

Please submit your CV and a short motivation. If you've built tools, automations, or agentic workflows you're proud of, make sure to include a link or short description as we'd love to see them.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values : caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As a Senior Business Consultant in Consulting, you will support our clients with best-practice market solutions and with services related to the use of SimCorp Dimension and beyond. You will work closely with local and global SimCorp teams, serving clients in their post-implementation phases. Drawing on your coordination skills and SimCorp Dimension expertise, you will collaborate with client and internal stakeholders on investment solutions, incident and problem management, and small changes or enhancements to current or future flows, all aimed at raising the level of automation and the end-user experience and satisfaction. Because the role is functional, Fund Administration & Accounting expertise is required. As part of your induction, you will work hands-on with our software and attend the three-week SimCorp Dimension® Academy, so you have steady support as you grow into the role.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Contribute to all aspects of SimCorp Dimension implementation projects.

• Advise on process improvements through better use of SimCorp Dimension, and help improve and document best practices for implementations.

• Map client needs to SimCorp Dimension functions and processes, and design and configure the setup.

• Lead the delivery of customised solutions with focus on Fund administration and Accounting.

• Assist clients in developing an overall test strategy and test plans, and support them in executing those plans.

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're creating a new role at the top of our Engineering career ladder: Lead Architect. It's the senior end of our Technical Track — the rung above Tech Lead — and today it's a role we've deliberately left lightly defined, because we want the first person in it to help define it. You'll set Factbird's technical direction: architecture, tooling, and the multi-year technology bets that shape where the product goes next.

This is our most senior technical role, with no direct reports — your authority comes from judgment and track record, not the org chart. You'll work alongside our Tech Leads in Factbird's technical leadership group, partner closely with our Director of Engineering, and be the person other senior engineers go to when a decision is genuinely hard to reverse.

**About the Role

**As Lead Architect, you own Factbird's company-wide technical vision: the architecture our services run on, the tooling and standards our engineers use every day, and the multi-year technology strategy that ties it all together. You make — or sign off on — the high-stakes, hard-to-reverse architecture calls, and you're accountable for getting them right with the full context of where the business is headed, not just where the code is today.

You'll work across a team built on Rust, React, Node.js, and AWS, with AI-assisted development already a core part of how we ship. Some of what this role owns is already well-defined — reviewing RFCs, stewarding language and platform standards, setting the team's AI-tooling strategy. Some of it isn't yet: Factbird is still a growing company, and part of the job is helping us figure out what technical leadership at this level should look like as we scale.

You'll thrive here if you'd rather be trusted with genuinely hard calls than manage a team, and if you can hold both the technical detail and the commercial context — cost, risk, market direction — well enough to make a technology bet you can still defend a year later.

**

What you'll do

**Architecture & technical strategy

• Own Factbird's multi-year technology strategy, and make the high-stakes architecture calls that are hard to reverse — with cost, risk, and business context factored in, not just engineering elegance

• Author and drive major RFCs from proposal through to an actual decision, and review the highest-risk architecture changes across the team

• Act as steward for our core languages and frameworks — setting standards, library choices, and the platform's overall shape

• Make build-vs-buy calls for new technical capabilities, and bring a clear point of view on emerging technologies worth adopting

• Define the observability, reliability, and security posture the platform is held to

**

Tooling & standards**

• Set the team's technical tooling and platform standards, and keep them evolving as the stack and the company grow

• Define Factbird's strategy for AI-assisted development — which tools we adopt, how we balance velocity against code quality, security, and IP risk, and where we draw the line

• Shape engineering-wide quality philosophy and help set the technical bar used in hiring interviews

• Help define shared components and reference architecture that other engineers build on, rather than reinvent

• Give input into technical org design and team topology as Engineering scales

**

Technical leadership & mentorship**

• Act as the trusted technical advisor to our Director of Engineering and the technical leadership group, partnering with Tech Leads and Product Leads on cross-team alignment

• Mentor senior engineers and Tech Leads toward architect-level thinking, without formal ownership of their people management

• Communicate technical vision and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including leadership

• Identify technical risks to the business early, and say so before they become expensive

• Represent Factbird's technical thinking externally where it makes sense — a talk, a blog post, an open-source contribution — though this isn't a requirement on day one

**What we’re looking for

**We're looking for someone who's already earned this kind of trust somewhere else — someone whose technical opinions carry weight because they're right more often than not, and who'd rather solve the interesting, ambiguous problem than manage the team solving it.

**

The ideal background**

• 8+ years of hands-on engineering experience, including real time spent as an architect or equivalent senior technical authority, not just a senior engineer with a bigger title

• A track record of owning multi-year technology strategy or platform architecture decisions that other teams had to live with — and that held up

• Has led major RFCs or architecture proposals cross-team, through genuine pushback, to an actual decision

• Comfortable making build-vs-buy and technology-adoption calls that account for cost, risk, and where the market is heading, not just what's technically interesting

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or Tech Leads toward architect-level thinking, without needing formal authority to do it

• Practical, current experience with AI-assisted development, and a clear point of view on where it genuinely helps versus where it creates risk

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

**

Here's what you can look forward to:**

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what's next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**

We'd love to hear from you

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

• Oversee core deliverables in molecular microbial expression, bioanalysis, PK and ADME for the protein and peptide research portfolio and cross-area strategic projects.

• Lead cross-functional collaboration across Research, CMC/GMS and external partners, acting as a key liaison to keep projects progressing.

• Proven experience leading leaders and managing cross-functional, high-performing research teams and strategic tasks.

• A track record of creating research and business results with impact at a senior level.

• Strong understanding of early drug research, complemented by broader knowledge of the drug development value chain, including clinical development, CMC and manufacturing methods

• Decisiveness in complex, uncertain research settings, with clear communication to executives, teams and external partners.

• High ethical standards and a commitment to developing research talent and future leaders.

You will lead outstanding scientific expertise at the front of peptide and protein drug discovery, with the trust to make decisions, set direction and shape how the area works. You will grow through cross-portfolio learning, senior collaboration and the chance to influence strategy across Research & Development. Instead, we are seeking a leader who excels at leading and motivating people, collaborates across boundaries, and puts enterprise priorities first—with a solid understanding of the drug R&D value chain and significant leadership experience in early drug discovery, biotechnology, or the pharmaceutical industry.
